templates.name: Hand hygiene (WHO 5 moments)
templates.description: Direct observation of 20 hand hygiene opportunities across the five moments. Record Yes when hand hygiene was performed correctly, No when it was missed.
moments: Before a clean or aseptic procedure
findings: Moved to the next patient without cleaning hands
Gloves worn instead of cleaning hands
Rub applied for less than 20 seconds
Hands not cleaned after touching the bed rail
Hand rub dispenser empty at the point of care

templates.name: Environmental cleaning
templates.description: Walk-round of patient rooms and shared areas against the cleaning schedule.
items: Floors are clean and dry with no visible spills
High-touch surfaces (rails, switches, handles) are visibly clean
Bathroom is clean with soap and paper available
Waste bins are not overflowing and are correctly lined
Cleaning schedule on the door is up to date and signed
Curtains are clean and within their change date
Mattress covers are intact and clean
Sluice room is clean and tidy
findings: Dust on the monitor and window sill
Cleaning schedule not signed for two days

templates.name: Sharps and waste
templates.description: Safe handling, segregation and disposal of sharps and clinical waste.
items: Sharps containers are below the fill line
Sharps containers are mounted or placed out of reach of children
Containers are labelled with the date and unit
Clinical and general waste are segregated correctly
No sharps are found in general waste or linen
Staff can describe the needle-stick injury procedure
Waste is stored in a locked area before collection
findings: Sharps container filled above the line
Sharps found in a general waste bag

templates.name: Isolation precautions
templates.description: Signage, equipment and practice for patients on isolation.
items: Isolation sign is on the door and matches the order in the notes
Gowns, gloves and masks are available outside the room
Staff put on and remove protective equipment in the correct order
A dedicated stethoscope and equipment are kept in the room
The door is kept closed (airborne precautions)
Visitors are instructed on precautions before entering
Room cleaning follows the isolation schedule
findings: Sign did not match the isolation order
Door left open on airborne precautions

templates.name: Medication storage
templates.description: Storage, labelling and security of medicines on the ward.
items: Medicine room and cupboards are locked
Fridge temperature has been recorded twice daily for the last week
Fridge contains only medicines
High-alert and look-alike medicines are separated and labelled
No medicines are past their expiry date
Opened multi-dose vials are dated
Controlled drugs are in a double-locked cupboard and the count matches the register
Emergency drugs are sealed and checked
findings: Fridge temperature not recorded on Saturday
